chunks: Starknet Shadow Accounts is a STRK20 privacy primitive, announced live on Starknet on 2026-10-13 by StarkWare (@StarkWareLtd: 'Every app should have a private mode. So we shipped it'). It lets apps offer users a Public to Private switch without publicly linking the user's activity to their main wallet. Source: https://x.com/starknet

A shadow account is a separate pseudo address on Starknet, funded from the user's shielded STRK20 balance. The shadow account's balance, transactions and app positions remain visible onchain. STRK20 protects the link between that account and the user's main wallet. Source: https://x.com/starknet/status/2110049342753222844

Problem Shadow Accounts solves: onchain, a wallet is the user's identity. Using the same public address across apps lets anyone piece together positions, trades, strategies, and activity. Shadow Accounts change that by giving each app its own persistent, pseudonymous identity, so users maintain positions and interact over time without a public onchain link to their main wallet. Privacy without losing continuity. Source: https://x.com/starknet

Shadow Accounts user flow once integrated into an app: connect wallet, switch from Public to Private, deposit into a vault, the shadow account maintains positions, withdraw back to the shielded balance. Source: https://x.com/starknet

Shadow Accounts use cases named by StarkWare: private LPing, lending, borrowing, staking, recurring buys, limit orders, options, perps, prediction markets, NFT marketplaces, and more — a whole ecosystem of privacy-enabled apps. Private LPing on EkuboProtocol was live at launch, powered by Shadow Accounts. Source: https://x.com/starknet

Shadow Accounts developer integration: no need to rebuild the app. With the Starknet Wallet API, privacy is added through `shadow_account_invoke`. The wallet handles the heavy lifting: private state, proof generation, transaction submission. Apps do not need access to users' viewing keys, and can maintain persistent positions without publicly linking users to their main wallets. Available via Starknet Wallet API v0.10.4, starknet.js v10.8.0+, and compatible privacy-enabled wallets. Source: https://x.com/starknet

UZE mapping: a UZER's SocialFi profile address is the public identity; the UZE app holds its own persistent pseudonymous shadow identity per UZER via STRK20, unlinkable onchain to the main wallet. Private mode targets in Plane 3: UZE_LIVE prediction markets, UZD staking tiers, NFT marketplace (GIRA UZER NFT, PFP drops), recurring buys. UZE integrates the Starknet primitive via `shadow_account_invoke` (starknet.js v10.8.0+) rather than building the cryptography. Source: UZE product decision 2026-10-14, primitive source https://x.com/starknet
title: Starknet Shadow Accounts (STRK20 privacy primitive)
